Name: Elkanah, Son of Korah
Summary: Elkanah was a son of Korah, the Levite, named in the genealogy of Moses' tribe — a different Elkanah from Samuel's father.
KeyStory: Elkanah is named with his brothers Assir and Abiasaph among Korah's sons.
RelatedPeople: Korah, Son of Izhar; Assir, Son of Korah; Abiasaph, Son of Korah
LifeLesson: Two men can share a name and walk very different paths; God knows each one.
